=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4056-4065 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new plain-ERROR branch in reviewer_failure_evidence keeps the first line starting with "ERROR" from any log, with no error-shape check (unlike the bash-diagnostic branch guarded by `_BASH_DIAGNOSTIC_MSG_RE`), and slot logs (raw model-CLI stderr / reviewer prose) are processed before reviewers_stage_stderr.txt (scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:49).
  WHY: A slot-log line becomes the failure_headline / AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR / "**First error:**" instead of the real crash, defeating spec item 3, and it also becomes the whole fingerprint signature (matches `\bERROR\b`), so the fp varies between runs of the same crash, the `GATE_FINGERPRINT_CAP_FP == autofix_failure_fp` check at post_editor_summary line 151 misses, and the "will retry" loop continues; all five reviewers rated it MAJOR (gemini filed it under SECURITY & INPUT VALIDATION).
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4047-4055 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The normalised bash diagnostic is added to the evidence but never reaches the fingerprint, because error_signature (lines 3844-3858) keeps only lines matching _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS (lines 573-578), and none of them matches "render_prompt.sh: line 306: 1abc: invalid variable name", "unbound variable", "command not found" or "bad substitution".
  WHY: Every reviewers_failed run whose evidence holds only a bash diagnostic and/or slot exit codes hashes to the constant fingerprint(workflow, "reviewers_failed", "no-error-lines"), so with the cap lowered to 2, two unrelated or transient reviewer failures on one head label ai:review-blocked and stop the retries.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:442-445 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The guard `! [[ "${carry_patch_audited}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]` needs exactly one 40-hex id, but `git patch-id` emits one id per file diff, so a PR that changes two or more files gives a multi-line value that never matches.
  WHY: The carry returns `reason=patch_mismatch` for every multi-file PR, so the base-sync carry (#9533 spec item 1) does nothing in the common case; the test only covers a single-file PR.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:141-155 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The repeated-failure decision uses the count captured by the gate, but the gate and the reviewer job run in separate concurrency groups (.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:323-325, 1937-1959).
  WHY: Two runs can both capture a stale count of zero before the first failure marker is posted, so the second identical failure posts another "will retry" comment instead of blocking; severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR, luna NIT, so the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:36521-36558 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The poller reads `--arg cap_enabled "${REVIEW_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_CAP_ENABLED:-true}"` (36534) for the `repeated_reviewer_failure` branch (36557-36558), but .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (lines 1509, 1697) never maps REVIEW_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_CAP_ENABLED.
  WHY: The documented kill switch cannot turn this rule off in the poller, which still reports `reason=repeated_reviewer_failure`; dispatch behaviour does not change because both outcomes skip, so this is report/contract drift.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:4062-4064 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The captured `ERROR: <msg>` line gets only `single_line(...)` and `redact_secrets(...)` before it is hashed into the fingerprint, despite the docstring's promise of stable fields (lines 4021-4022).
  WHY: Two identical crashes whose first ERROR line differs only in a delay or attempt count produce different `fp=` values, so the 2-strike block falls back to "will retry".
- scripts/review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh:118 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Post-editor-summary computes the fingerprint before the resolver writes resolver_stage_stderr.txt, while scripts/review_autofix_step_assemble_failure_evidence.sh computes it after.
  WHY: The two markers can differ for the same crash, which keeps the gate's identical-failure count below 2 and triggers an extra "will retry" cycle.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3998-4008 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The bash-diagnostic regex in _normalise_bash_diagnostic is strictly anchored to `<script>: line <n>: <msg>`.
  WHY: Crash formats that do not fit fall back to the generic ERROR capture or an empty string, which affects fingerprint stability.
- scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:442-445 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The carry's proof that "the merge changed nothing of the PR's files" is a `git patch-id --verbatim` comparison, and patch-id ignores binary diffs; the file-set check at 434-440 only proves the same files are listed.
  WHY: When a base-side merge changes a binary file the PR also changed, the carry succeeds (`outcome=clean reason=base_sync_carry`, `hold=false`) and the head skips the security audit.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Fill AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR from the reviewer step's first ERROR/bash diagnostic line ... so the failure comment and the fingerprint carry the cause." (spec item 3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py error_signature / _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS, plus a test in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: The diff adds the diagnostic only to reviewers_failure_evidence.txt and failure_headline, and no hunk changes _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS or error_signature, so "invalid variable name" is filtered out before hashing; no test checks that the fp differs between two different crash lines; the comment half is met, the fingerprint half is not.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:_normalise_bash_diagnostic / reviewer_failure_evidence lines 4047-4055 (bash_diagnostic appended to helper_lines), checked against error_signature lines 3844-3858 and _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS lines 573-578, which autofix_failure_fingerprint (line 4950) calls | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The normalised bash diagnostic never reaches the fp: error_signature keeps only lines matching the four _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS, and none of them matches "render_prompt.sh: line 306: 1abc: invalid variable name", "unbound variable", "command not found" or "bad substitution". The other evidence lines ("reviewers_failed=true", "exit=124", "dominant_rc=") do not match either. review_autofix_run_summary_line.txt is written after both fingerprint call sites (workflow line 5978).
  WHY: Every such reviewers_failed run gets fingerprint(workflow, "reviewers_failed", "no-error-lines"), so with the cap lowered to 2 (FINGERPRINT_CAP_REVIEWERS_FAILED_MAX; review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh lines 140-166), two unrelated or transient failures label ai:review-blocked. The tests use a synthetic "e"*64 fp. Fix: add a fifth, lowest-priority pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\.sh: line \d+: ` and a test that two different diagnostics give different fps.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:reviewer_failure_evidence lines 4056-4065 (plain_error = _PLAIN_ERROR_LINE_RE.match(line) ... helper_lines.append(... "ERROR: " + msg ...)) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The plain-ERROR branch keeps the first line starting with "ERROR" from any reviewer log. Slot logs are read before reviewers_stage_stderr.txt (review_autofix_step_post_editor_summary.sh line 49) and hold raw CLI stderr (review_run_reviewers.sh lines 4672, 4709, 4718; opencode `--print-logs` at scripts/opencode_helpers.sh line 83, `--log-level INFO` at scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh line 896). There is no error-shape check, and this line alone matches signature pattern 4.
  WHY: (a) failure_headline names CLI noise instead of the crash, which defeats spec item 3. (b) Letter-based request ids survive normalize_error_line, so the fp drifts, the check at post_editor_summary line 151 misses, and the retry loop continues. Fix: keep the line only from the stage stderr or only when no bash diagnostic was kept, and normalise it.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Fill AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FIRST_ERROR from the reviewer step's first ERROR/bash diagnostic line ... so the failure comment and the fingerprint carry the cause." (spec item 3) | Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py, in error_signature / _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS, plus a test in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py | Evidence of absence: no hunk changes _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS or error_signature, and no test checks that the fp differs between crash lines; the fingerprint half is not met | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): _SIGNATURE_PATTERNS (line 573-578): append the `.sh: line N:` pattern (1-2 lines); reviewer_failure_evidence lines 4056-4065: restrict the plain ERROR line (4-6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
